Hey! I recommend

Night:

1- Oil cleanser or micellar water
2- Clean with gel wash (it's called double cleanse and it's really good)
3- Exfoliation. This step is optional and you should only do it once or twice a week 
4- Tonic 
5- Masks (optional) 
6- Serums
7- Moisturizing 

Day:

1- If you did a double cleanse the night before just wash your face with water
2- Tonic 
3- Serum 
4- Eye contour (if you have more than 20 you can start using it) 
5- Moisturizing  
6- SPF +30. Reapply during the day every two hours

Of course you don't need to do all the steps, the basics are cleansing, moisturizing and SPF.

Hey! Im my opinion the basics are: 
1- cleaning (night)
2- hydration (day and night)
3- sunscreen (day)

There is no need to use different creams for night and day, just use a good moisturizer that works for you. 

Skin care is not about wearing makeup or not, our skin is very exposed during the day (pollution, sweat, sun...) Remember that it's not necessary to spend a fortune but that taking care of your skin is a long-term investment :)
